name: B10-0413/2025 (ESN) – Humanitarian and security situation in Haiti, in particular the rising power of criminal gangs and the recent massacre in Cabaret
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the humanitarian and security situation in Haiti, in particular the rising power of criminal gangs and the recent massacre in Cabaret
part_text:
The European Parliament is giving its opinion, not changing any law. It says Haiti's crisis is political as well as criminal, with gangs used by elites to gain power. It calls the European Union's budget support to Haiti a waste of money. It supports the Dominican Republic sending back illegal Haitian migrants. It wants countries in the region to work together to cut off gang money, fight drug and people trafficking, and prosecute those responsible.

- The Parliament asks for closer regional cooperation against gang finances and trafficking; no law changes.
- It backs the Dominican Republic's returns of illegal migrants, affecting Haitian migrants there.
- It calls the European Union's budget support to Haiti a waste; no decision is taken.
